attacks.name: Spirit Venom
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before damage is dealt, the target character loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.
|!hit| |!hit| |*Spiritual Strength|: After this attack is resolved, if the target character is Size 2 or less, Throw it |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Staff of Legba
steps: |!wild| |*Power Burn|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the target character loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll. The target character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!power| lost in this way, and does not gain |!power| for |!damage| suffered as a result of Power Burn.

superPowers.name: Possession
superPowers.body: This character may spend any number of |!power| to use this superpower. Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character with a Threat Value equal to or lower than the amount of |!power| spent to use this superpower. Move the |<brother_daniel>Brother Daniel| token to that character. The enemy character drops all objective tokens it is holding. While that character has the Brother Daniel token, it cannot hold objective tokens.

superPowers.name: Recall Spirit
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack it may use this superpower. Move the |<brother_daniel>Brother Daniel| token to this character from anywhere.

superPowers.name: Spirit of Brother Daniel
superPowers.body: This character begins the game with a |<brother_daniel>Brother Daniel| token. While this character has the token, add 2 dice to all of its defense and dodge rolls. Whenever this character is Dazed, or another character is Dazed or KO’d while it has the Brother Daniel token, move the token to this character. This character cannot have a Brother Daniel token except the one it begins the game with. When this character is removed from the battlefield, remove its Brother Daniel token from the game.|\|Whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least one |!failure|.

erratas.body: The "Spiritual Strength" superpower was removed. Instead, a "Spiritual Strength" special rule was added to "Spirit Venom". Doctor Voodoo cannot Throw terrain anymore.
"Possession" was changed so that having a Brother Daniel token does not prevent from Interacting with or Contesting objective tokens.
Power cost for "Recall Spirit" increased from 2 to 3.
The recall conditions for Brother Daniel token have been updated in "Spirit of Brother Daniel".
